newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PRIMEDIA SAYS ACQUISITION ANNOUNCEMENT SOON.
newsitem.headline: PRIMEDIA SAYS ACQUISITION ANNOUNCEMENT SOON.

text.p: Broadcasting and publishing company Primedia Ltd said on Friday that negotiations in respect of a material acquisition were at an advanced stage and an announcement was anticipated shortly.
Primedia announced it was in talks on June 17.
The company said that these negotiations, if successfully concluded, could have an effect on the price at which Primedia combined units were trading on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
Primedia advised its unitholders to exercise caution when dealing in combined units until a further announcement was made.

Business Day newspaper reported on Friday that Primedia has reached an agreement in principle to set up a consortium with the South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC) to bid for a new private sector commercial television channel.

Primedia currently has a 10 percent stake in the Free-to-Air consortium which is bidding. But if it successfully concludes a deal to acquire Interleisure Ltd , it would gain a diluted stake in Station for the Nation, one of the favourites bidding for the private television licence, the paper said.

It also quoted Primedia chief executive William Kirsch as saying that if Primedia bought Interleisure Ltd, "someone else" would take care of Interleisure's stake in a bid for private television, leaving Primedia involved in only one bid.
